metadata.name: Pantry Raid
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: Toy soldiers at war in a giant kitchen. The counter run is 12 m up: a sliding cupboard door over a ramp and a hatch, a sink of dish water to swim, a chopping board ramp, and an oven whose door slams down into a ramp when you turn the knob (flame-jet burners and a glowing element inside, a flue ladder out by the cookie jar). A knocked-over toaster pops you onto the counter, the fridge has a crawlspace with a box of CRUNCH-O'S under it and a sniper perch on top, and the kitchen table stands 8 m tall with chairs, plates, cups and a bowl of milk. CTF flags: the cookie jar and the sugar bowl.
